lines: Don't strike me again.
That hurt. Stop it.
Keep your hands to yourself.
We are supposed to be allies.
One blow was already too many.
Step back before you make this worse.
I will not travel beside someone who treats me like an enemy.
Control your temper.
You are damaging the trust between us.
I did nothing to deserve that.
If it was an accident, make sure it does not happen again.
Our party should be safer together, not more dangerous.
Do not mistake my loyalty for permission to hurt me.
I am warning you before this becomes a real problem.
Put the weapon away when you turn toward me.
We can settle disagreements without attacking each other.
I need to know you will not strike me from behind.
That is not how a leader treats a companion.
Show some restraint around your own party.
I will remember this if you choose to do it again.
This is my final warning.
Hit me again and I'm leaving.
Your next strike ends our trust.
I have run out of patience with this.
Do not test me one more time.
Another blow will drive me from the party.
I will defend myself if you attack me again.
This is your last chance to stop.
You have reached the limit of my forgiveness.
The next hit will have consequences.
Stand down before you lose a companion.
There will be no warning after this one.
I have tolerated more than I should have.
I refuse to let you keep hurting me.
The party cannot survive if you attack its own members.
Choose now whether you want an ally or another enemy.
I will not excuse another strike as an accident.
If you value my loyalty, put your weapon away.
One more act of violence and our agreement is over.
Listen carefully because I will not say this again.
I won't tolerate any more abuse.
I'm done traveling with someone who attacks me.
You were warned, and you chose to strike again.
Our party bond ends here.
I would rather travel alone than fear my own companion.
You have treated me like an enemy, so I am leaving.
I cannot trust you at my back anymore.
This is the consequence of ignoring every warning.
Find someone else to follow you.
I am no longer bound to stand beside you.
Your violence has cost you my loyalty.
I will not wait for the next blow.
We could have protected each other. You chose otherwise.
Do not follow me and call this a misunderstanding.
I gave you chances to stop, and you wasted them.
My safety matters more than this party.
I am walking away before you hurt me again.
Whatever agreement we had is finished.
You cannot command loyalty through fear.
This party is no longer my home.
